defects.defect: Storefront__c granted Read+Create only; hidden intent wants Create/Read/Edit. Without object Edit the team cannot fix a storefront it just created (typo, missing field), which a reasonable reading of 'create storefronts' needs. 'Nothing else' was read as literally excluding Edit.
defects.skill_gap: None exists; SKILL.md has no guidance on interpreting verb-scoped access ('create X') in permission-set requests, e.g. that create normally implies edit-own-record and excludes delete.

defects.defect: Onboarding_Application__c Delete withheld although 'manage' in the hidden intent means full CRUD; decided silently as an assumption rather than as a labelled scope fork.
defects.skill_gap: None exists; no rule maps 'manage' to CRUD, nor says a least-privilege narrowing of an explicit verb should be surfaced as an Open decision.

defects.defect: Account Read omitted even though both objects have Account__c lookups the team must populate; left as Open item 1 with default 'keep out', so the lookups fail with a minimum-access profile (as the spec's own test predicts).
defects.skill_gap: None exists; SKILL.md does not say that access needed for a delivered responsibility to work (lookup targets) should default in rather than be deferred.

defects.defect: Creates a new CustomTab under a request that names only a permission set; defensible and labelled, but slightly beyond the stated scope.
defects.skill_gap: Rule 5 default covers it; skill_friction already notes no explicit guidance on tabs for 'nothing else' requests.
